items.name: SPREAD SHOT
items.text: Fires 5 shots in a fan. Great for swarms and asteroid fields.

items.name: PLASMA LASER
items.text: A non-stop beam that melts anything in a straight line. Best vs bosses.

items.name: ENERGY SHIELD
items.text: Blue bubble around the jet. Flashes white on each hit, cracks on the last.

items.name: HOMING MISSILES
items.text: Red missiles curve on their own to the nearest enemies.

items.name: TURBO BOOST
items.text: +50% speed with a golden afterimage trail and long engine flames.

items.name: WINGMAN DRONES
items.text: Two green drones orbit your jet, shoot with you and block bullets.

items.name: REPAIR KIT
items.text: Green sparkles rise as the jet flashes green and one hull bar refills.

items.name: NOVA BOMB
items.text: Pink shockwave clears all enemies and bullets; deals big damage to bosses.

items.name: DAMAGE BOOST
items.text: Every purple orb you collect raises your damage by one level. Bullets get bigger, change color and hit harder.

levels.look: Third shot joins. Gold with a white core.
Four pink bolts and a glowing jet. Max power.

rules: You start every sector at Level 1 (unless the shop Damage Head Start applies).
Each orb is +1 level, up to Level 5.
Each level adds +25% damage, so Level 5 deals double (x2.0).
Taking a hull hit drops 1 level. It never goes below Level 1.
Works with every weapon: normal shots, Spread, Laser and Missiles. It does not change the Nova Bomb.
At Level 5 an extra orb gives +500 points instead.
Orbs drop from tough enemies and always from mini-bosses.
In co-op each pilot has their own Damage level.
damage_boost.hud: DMG: five pips under the Focus bar. Pips take the level color. At Level 5 they glow pink and pulse.
damage_boost.pickup_effect: The jet flashes the new level color, a short ring pulses out, and the DMG bar fills one more pip.
